judgment_calls.decision: Pressure ulcer likely = ulcer/wound and (bed-ridden or wheelchair-dependent); the 'common pressure ulcer site' condition is dropped because the sites are only shown in a picture.
judgment_calls.alternatives: finding_site list of the pictured sites (occiput, spine, shoulder blades, elbows, sacrum, hips, heels) read from the image

judgment_calls.topic: Q1 = No not required on later branches
judgment_calls.decision: Arterial/venous/diabetic rules do not require 'not pressure ulcer', because Q1's No cannot be expressed without the site half; a bedridden patient with a leg ulcer can get both pressure and arterial/venous/diabetic diagnoses.
judgment_calls.alternatives: (no Bed-ridden) and (no Dependence on wheelchair) on each later rule (would fire less often than the page intends)

judgment_calls.decision: Infection = infected ulcer of skin, local wound infection, or any one of erythema, warm skin, swelling (no site).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Require all three signs; or only a recorded infection concept

judgment_calls.decision: Venous and diabetic rules require explicit (no ...) records for each item of the earlier questions.

judgment_calls.topic: Critical limb ischaemia requires the ulcer
judgment_calls.decision: The probable CLI rule includes the ulcer/wound complaint because the red box is about patients with an ulcer or wound.
judgment_calls.alternatives: CLI from claudication + rest pain/gangrene alone
